newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices volatile this week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices volatile this week.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to continue to be volatile in the fine to medium types at sales this week, pastrol group Wesfrmers Dalgety said.
Sales this week are in Sydney and Geelong with 69,566 bales on offer.
The eastern market indicator fell 15 cents to 574 cents a kilo clean. The western market indicator fell five cents to 520 cents a kilo clean.
Wesfarmers said prices fell considerably last week with excess quantities of fine to medium wools on offer, eroding the significant price differentials.
"This indicates that further significant falls for these types are unlikely if Chinese activity remains at current levels," Wesfarmers said.
Despite current limited interest from many of these buyers, a number of European trade fairs were just beginning.

"These will offer direction as to the trends for textiles for 1996/97 and given that a majority of their orders are now done for prompt delivery rather than for stock, it is hoped these fairs stimulate buying activity," Wesfarmers said.
